subject: I have 5 sets of 5 rounders that will test you all,
author: SUFFUR
body:
I'll get a DNF but at least the tracks are good, if you know your roads. Some nice corners, and some good areas for site seeing if you do get lost, lol. And they are curcuits, sort of, due to only 8 finish spots.

But the map edit is a bugger to use, place check point, check the route, zoom in again etc etc, but my Save Nine I think will get some good races if people just flollow the roads and know a check point is a turn or a straight?

 As for traffic first timers no traffic, but if you done the game, traffic will be on.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

Also I need a map with all the check points on, so i can plan better routes, some corners in the game are just so sweet and i want them in races. A big map too, i need to see the roads properly, so i know where short cuts are, so they can be used and not send people else where?

subject: Paradise Drives
author: FrozenVapor
body: Usually I pick random tracks from the preset Paradise Drives when I host a room. People tend to be able to keep up with those pretty well. If I feel like upping the challenge a bit, I just stick in a couple checkpoints...

subject: Had some goals
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
I haven't done a whole lot of races yet because I kind of had a plan for how I wanted to attack Paradise.   Now that I 've got all that stuff done (getting all my cars and getting my friends acclimated to the game,  bugger those last 14 smashes and 3 stunt runs, it'll happen whenever it happens)  I'm diving head first into racing now.  Challenges are fun everynow and then or to help a friend who doesn't have them but Its all racing from now on for me baby!   Look for my room,  see you out there!
